**Byline:** 明 元賢述

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-fascicle (10卷) **abridged commentary** (*lüèshū* 略疏) on the *Śūraṃgama-sūtra* ([KR6j0118](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0118)) by **Yǒngjué Yuánxián** 永覺元賢 [元賢](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E8%B3%A2) (1578 – 1657), the late-Míng / early-Qīng Cáodòng-line Chán master of the Gǔshān Yǒngquánsì 鼓山湧泉寺 in Fújiàn. Preserved as **X15 no. 302** in the *Xùzàngjīng*. The work is the abridged successor to Yuánxián's earlier *Lèngyán jīng yìjiě* 楞嚴經翼解 ([楞嚴經翼解](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Titles/%E6%A5%9E%E5%9A%B4%E7%B6%93%E7%BF%BC%E8%A7%A3)) (two fascicles, drafted 1624) and was completed at the end of Chóngzhēn 11 / 1638, after a multi-year drafting period split between Quánzhōu Kāiyuánsì 泉州開元寺, Gǔshān, and the Zhēnjì 真寂 retreat near Tiáoxī 苕溪.

**Abstract**

The *Lüèshū* represents Yuánxián's mature and expressly **non-sectarian** reading of the *Śūraṃgama*: he positions himself outside both the Tiāntái-school and Huāyán/Xiánshǒu-school commentarial lineages and seeks a single synthetic voice. The work was rapidly recognized within the seventeenth-century Cáodòng commentarial sphere and circulated alongside Yuánxián's other major exegetical contributions (the *Jìdēng lù* 繼燈錄 ([KR6q0038](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0038)) and the *Yǒngjué Yuánxián chánshī guǎnglù* 永覺元賢禪師廣錄 ([永覺元賢禪師廣錄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Titles/%E6%B0%B8%E8%A6%BA%E5%85%83%E8%B3%A2%E7%A6%AA%E5%B8%AB%E5%BB%A3%E9%8C%84)) in the Jiāxīng canon). Dating bracket: 1624 (the earliest *Yìjiě* draft, which the *Lüèshū* incorporates) – 1638 (completion of the present recension, per the colophon).
